name: test

# yamllint disable-line rule:truthy
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  unit:
    name: unit
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v4
        with:
          terraform_wrapper: false
      - name: Build
        run: go build ./...
      - name: Check generated docs and examples
        run: |
          go generate ./...
          git diff --exit-code docs examples
      - name: Test
        run: go test ./...
      - name: Test with the race detector
        run: go test -race ./...

  acceptance:
    name: acceptance
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v4
        with:
          terraform_wrapper: false
      # Keep this tag equal to the docket version in go.mod;
      # TestSetupDokkuMatchesDocket fails otherwise.
      - uses: dokku/docket/.github/actions/setup-dokku@v0.11.0
      - name: Acceptance tests
        env:
          TF_ACC: "1"
          DOKKU_SUDO: "true"

# dokku_builder_dockerfile_property (Resource)

Manages the builder-dockerfile configuration for a given dokku application

### Requirements

- Dokku >= 0.38.8

### Export support

Supported.

### Probe support

Supported.

### Lifecycle

Applied with state `present` and torn down with state `absent`, which refuses `value`, so a teardown resets it. See [Applying and tearing down a task](https://github.com/dokku/docket/blob/v0.11.0/docs/embedding.md#applying-and-tearing-down-a-task).

### Identity

Keyed by `app`, `global`, and `property`. Fields left empty are omitted from the address.

### Objects

- The app named by `app`.

Tasks applied at once on the same object take turns; see [Running tasks concurrently](https://github.com/dokku/docket/blob/v0.11.0/docs/embedding.md#running-tasks-concurrently).

### Constraints

- Exactly one of `app` or `global` must be set.

### Properties

`property` accepts one of the following, applied with `dokku builder-dockerfile:set`. A property with no form in a scope is rejected there, matching dokku's own rejection.

| Property | Scopes | Report key (app) | Report key (global) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dockerfile-path` | app, global | `dockerfile-path` | `global-dockerfile-path` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dokku_app" "node_js_app" {
  app = "node-js-app"
}

# Setting the dockerfile path for an app
resource "dokku_builder_dockerfile_property" "example" {
  app      = dokku_app.node_js_app.app
  property = "dockerfile-path"
  value    = "Dockerfile.production"
}

# Setting the dockerfile path globally
resource "dokku_builder_dockerfile_property" "example_2" {
  global   = true
  property = "dockerfile-path"
  value    = "Dockerfile"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `property` (String) Name of the property to set
- `value` (String) Value to set for the property (required)

### Optional

- `app` (String) Name of the app
- `global` (Boolean) Flag indicating if the property should be applied globally

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource's identity address, such as `dokku_builder_dockerfile_property[app=api]`.

## Import

Import by the resource's identity address:

```shell
terraform import dokku_builder_dockerfile_property.example 'dokku_builder_dockerfile_property[app=node-js-app,property=dockerfile-path]'
```

# dokku_http_auth_allowed_ip (Resource)

Manages the set of IP addresses allowed to bypass HTTP auth for a dokku application

### Requirements

- Dokku >= 0.38.31
- dokku-http-auth plugin >= 0.14.0

### Export support

Supported.

### Probe support

Supported.

### Lifecycle

Applied with state `set` and torn down with state `clear`, which refuses `allowed_ips`, so a teardown resets it. See [Applying and tearing down a task](https://github.com/dokku/docket/blob/v0.11.0/docs/embedding.md#applying-and-tearing-down-a-task).

### Identity

Keyed by `app`. Manages the whole `allowed_ips` collection; entries are identified by value.

### Objects

- The app named by `app`.

Tasks applied at once on the same object take turns; see [Running tasks concurrently](https://github.com/dokku/docket/blob/v0.11.0/docs/embedding.md#running-tasks-concurrently).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dokku_plugin" "http_auth" {
  name = "http-auth"
  url  = "https://github.com/dokku/dokku-http-auth.git"
}

resource "dokku_app" "hello_world" {
  app = "hello-world"
}

resource "dokku_http_auth" "hello_world_http_auth" {
  app        = dokku_app.hello_world.app
  depends_on = [dokku_plugin.http_auth]
}

# Allow IP addresses to bypass HTTP auth for an app
resource "dokku_http_auth_allowed_ip" "example" {
  app         = dokku_app.hello_world.app
  allowed_ips = ["192.0.2.1", "198.51.100.0/24"]
  depends_on  = [dokku_plugin.http_auth, dokku_http_auth.hello_world_http_auth]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) Name of the app

### Optional

- `allowed_ips` (Set of String) List of IP addresses to allow or remove

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource's identity address, such as `dokku_http_auth_allowed_ip[app=api]`.

## Import

Import by the resource's identity address:

```shell
terraform import dokku_http_auth_allowed_ip.example 'dokku_http_auth_allowed_ip[app=hello-world]'
```

# dokku_registry_auth (Resource)

Manages docker registry authentication for a dokku application or globally

### Requirements

- Dokku >= 0.38.29

### Export support

Partial - registry:report names the servers a credential exists for, so the logins a server needs are reconstructed; the username and password behind each one are not readable and are lifted into required inputs the caller supplies before apply.

### Probe support

Supported.

### Lifecycle

Applied with state `present` and torn down with state `absent`. See [Applying and tearing down a task](https://github.com/dokku/docket/blob/v0.11.0/docs/embedding.md#applying-and-tearing-down-a-task).

### Identity

Keyed by `app`, `global`, and `server`. Fields left empty are omitted from the address.

### Objects

- The app named by `app`.

Tasks applied at once on the same object take turns; see [Running tasks concurrently](https://github.com/dokku/docket/blob/v0.11.0/docs/embedding.md#running-tasks-concurrently).

### Constraints

- Exactly one of `app` or `global` must be set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dokku_app" "node_js_app" {
  app = "node-js-app"
}

# Log in to a registry for an app
resource "dokku_registry_auth" "example" {
  app      = dokku_app.node_js_app.app
  server   = "ghcr.io"
  username = "deploy-bot"
  password = "[REDACTED]"
}

# Log in to a registry globally
resource "dokku_registry_auth" "example_2" {
  global   = true
  server   = "docker.io"
  username = "deploy-bot"
  password = "[REDACTED]"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Registry password (required) (not returned when reading state) (sensitive)
- `server` (String) Docker registry hostname (e.g. docker.io, ghcr.io)
- `username` (String) Registry username (required) (not returned when reading state)

### Optional

- `app` (String) Name of the app
- `global` (Boolean) Flag indicating if the registry credential should be applied globally

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource's identity address, such as `dokku_registry_auth[app=api]`.

## Import

Import by the resource's identity address:

```shell
terraform import dokku_registry_auth.example 'dokku_registry_auth[app=node-js-app,server=ghcr.io]'
```

# dokku_http_auth_domain (Resource)

Manages the set of domains HTTP auth is restricted to for a dokku application

### Requirements

- Dokku >= 0.38.31
- dokku-http-auth plugin >= 0.14.0

### Export support

Supported.

### Probe support

Supported.

### Lifecycle

Applied with state `set` and torn down with state `clear`, which refuses `domains`, so a teardown resets it. See [Applying and tearing down a task](https://github.com/dokku/docket/blob/v0.11.0/docs/embedding.md#applying-and-tearing-down-a-task).

### Identity

Keyed by `app`. Manages the whole `domains` collection; entries are identified by value.

### Objects

- The app named by `app`.

Tasks applied at once on the same object take turns; see [Running tasks concurrently](https://github.com/dokku/docket/blob/v0.11.0/docs/embedding.md#running-tasks-concurrently).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dokku_plugin" "http_auth" {
  name = "http-auth"
  url  = "https://github.com/dokku/dokku-http-auth.git"
}

resource "dokku_app" "hello_world" {
  app = "hello-world"
}

resource "dokku_http_auth" "hello_world_http_auth" {
  app        = dokku_app.hello_world.app
  depends_on = [dokku_plugin.http_auth]
}

  app        = dokku_app.hello_world.app
  domains    = ["app.example.com", "www.example.com"]

### Optional

### Read-Only

## Import

Import by the resource's identity address:

```shell

Users given by hash converge on their own and ignore this (applied only, not read back) - `users` (Attributes Set) List of HTTP auth users to add or remove. Each item has: username, password, hash. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users)) ### Read-Only - `id` (String) The resource's identity address, such as `dokku_http_auth_user[app=api]`. ### Nested Schema for `users` Required: - `username` (String) HTTP auth username Optional: - `hash` (String, Sensitive) htpasswd hash for the user, as emitted by http-auth:export-users; applied over stdin with http-auth:import-users so it never reaches argv (sensitive) - `password` (String, Sensitive) Cleartext HTTP auth password, applied with http-auth:add-user (not returned when reading state) (sensitive) ## Import Import by the resource's identity address: ```shell terraform import dokku_http_auth_user.example 'dokku_http_auth_user[app=hello-world]' ```

# dokku_scheduler_k3s_autoscaling_auth (Resource)

Manages KEDA TriggerAuthentication metadata grouped under a single trigger for a dokku application or globally

### Requirements

- Dokku >= 0.38.31

### Export support

Partial - trigger authentication metadata values are secrets, so they are written to the companion vars-file.

### Probe support

Supported.

### Lifecycle

Applied with state `set` and torn down with state `clear`, which refuses `metadata`, so a teardown resets it. See [Applying and tearing down a task](https://github.com/dokku/docket/blob/v0.11.0/docs/embedding.md#applying-and-tearing-down-a-task).

### Identity

Keyed by `app`, `global`, and `trigger`. Fields left empty are omitted from the address. Manages the whole `metadata` collection; entries are identified by their key.

### Objects

- The app named by `app`.

Tasks applied at once on the same object take turns; see [Running tasks concurrently](https://github.com/dokku/docket/blob/v0.11.0/docs/embedding.md#running-tasks-concurrently).

### Constraints

- Exactly one of `app` or `global` must be set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dokku_app" "node_js_app" {
  app = "node-js-app"
}

# Set AWS secret manager trigger metadata on an app
resource "dokku_scheduler_k3s_autoscaling_auth" "example" {
  app     = dokku_app.node_js_app.app
  trigger = "aws-secret-manager"
  metadata = {
    awsRegion  = "us-east-1"
    secretName = "my-secret"
  }
}

# Set a global trigger authentication shared across apps
resource "dokku_scheduler_k3s_autoscaling_auth" "example_2" {
  global  = true
  trigger = "aws-secret-manager"
  metadata = {
    awsRegion = "us-east-1"
    roleArn   = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/keda"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `trigger` (String) Name of the KEDA trigger authentication resource

### Optional

- `app` (String) Name of the app
- `global` (Boolean) Flag indicating if the trigger authentication should be applied globally
- `metadata` (Map of String) Map of metadata key to value for the trigger authentication. On absent, only the keys are read. A key must not contain '='.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource's identity address, such as `dokku_scheduler_k3s_autoscaling_auth[app=api]`.

## Import

Import by the resource's identity address:

```shell
terraform import dokku_scheduler_k3s_autoscaling_auth.example 'dokku_scheduler_k3s_autoscaling_auth[app=node-js-app,trigger=aws-secret-manager]'
```

# dokku_http_auth (Resource)

Manages HTTP authentication for a given dokku application

### Requirements

- Dokku >= 0.38.31
- dokku-http-auth plugin >= 0.14.0

### Export support

Partial - the enabled state is exported; the seeded credentials are not carried on this task and come back as dokku_http_auth_user htpasswd hashes.

### Probe support

Supported.

### Lifecycle

name: 'bump-version'

# yamllint disable-line rule:truthy
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      bump_type:
        description: 'Bump type'
        default: 'patch'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - patch
          - minor
          - major

# A tag pushed with the default GITHUB_TOKEN does not start other workflows,
# so the tag is pushed with a token that lets the release workflow run.
env:
  GITHUB_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_ACCESS_TOKEN }}

jobs:
  bump-version:
    name: bump-version
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ env.GITHUB_ACCESS_TOKEN }}

      - name: Get Latest Tag
        id: latest-tag
        run: |
          GIT_LATEST_TAG="$(git describe --tags "$(git rev-list --tags --max-count=1)" 2>/dev/null || echo "0.0.0")"
          echo GIT_LATEST_TAG="${GIT_LATEST_TAG#v}" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Compute Next Tag
        id: next-tag
        uses: docker://ghcr.io/dokku/semver-generator:latest
        with:
          bump: ${{ github.event.inputs.bump_type }}
          input: ${{ steps.latest-tag.outputs.GIT_LATEST_TAG }}

      - name: Create and Push Tag
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'Dokku Bot'
          git config --global user.email no-reply@dokku.com
          # The Terraform Registry only accepts vX.Y.Z tags.
          git tag "v$GIT_NEXT_TAG"
          git push origin "v$GIT_NEXT_TAG"
        env:
          GIT_NEXT_TAG: ${{ steps.next-tag.outputs.version }}

# dokku_storage_ensure (Resource)

Ensures the storage for a given dokku application

> **Deprecated:** use dokku_storage_entry instead; dokku's storage:ensure-directory has been deprecated in favor of storage:create

### Requirements

- Dokku >= 0.38.31

### Export support

Not supported - deprecated; storage state is exported via dokku_storage_mount.

### Probe support

Not supported - `storage:ensure-directory` has no read command, so the task plans as drift on every run.

### Lifecycle

Applied with state `present` and has no teardown state, so tearing it down leaves the server unchanged. See [Applying and tearing down a task](https://github.com/dokku/docket/blob/v0.11.0/docs/embedding.md#applying-and-tearing-down-a-task).

### Identity

Keyed by `app`.

### Objects

- The app named by `app`.

Tasks applied at once on the same object take turns; see [Running tasks concurrently](https://github.com/dokku/docket/blob/v0.11.0/docs/embedding.md#running-tasks-concurrently).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dokku_app" "node_js_app" {
  app = "node-js-app"
}

# Ensure a storage directory owned by the herokuish user
resource "dokku_storage_ensure" "example" {
  app   = dokku_app.node_js_app.app
  chown = "herokuish"
}
```
